panelTitle: Who can do what on Employees
ariaLabel: Open help: Admin and IT Ops permissions on the Employees page

sections.heading: Admin
bullets: Use Make Admin or Revoke Admin on Employee and Admin rows.
You cannot change IT Ops users or assign the IT Ops role; only IT Ops can do that.
Revoke Admin is disabled on your own row so you cannot remove your own admin access here.
Edit employee details, download QR codes for assigned assets, and move others to the Recycle Bin (delete is blocked on your own row).

sections.heading: IT Ops
bullets: Use Set Employee, Set Admin, and Set IT Ops (with confirmations) to set roles on rows you are allowed to manage.
Use Revoke Admin on users who are already Admin. Make Admin is not shown for you—use Set Admin instead.
You cannot revoke admin on your own row from this page.
Edit, QR download, and Recycle Bin follow the same rules as for admins.
